notes: Justia's 2025 vintage of Title 42 Chapter 42.17A still hosts the lobbying-side sections (.600-.655) ALONGSIDE the campaign-finance sections (.400 series, .500 series, .700 series financial-affairs). The 2024-2025 RCW reorg moved these to Title 29B Chapter 29B.50, but Justia 2025 snapshot shows both — likely a transitional state. To avoid silently undercounting if 29B.50 turns out incomplete or non-authoritative, the 13 lobbying-core sections from 42.17A are included as legacy mirrors with explicit rationale linking to their 29B.50 equivalents. Downstream Phase C can deduplicate by semantic identity using the (mirror of NN) rationale tags. Definitions section 42.17A.005 was NOT proposed because in 2025 it appears to have moved entirely to 29B.10 (atomized per-term); 42.17A.005 is not in the 2025 chapter snapshot. Enforcement sections (42.17A.750/.755/.765/.770) are also covered via 29B.60, so they are not double-listed from 42.17A here.
